business_process: Drinking water treatment and chemical feed
description: Run source water intakes and wells, treatment, disinfection, pH and corrosion control, and chemical feed at 214 plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Storage covers about 8 to 24 hours of demand while holding fire reserve (GCR about 12 hours); loss of treatment or unsafe chemical feed is a public health event and a Tier 1 public notice trigger (40 CFR 141.202); RTO is the time to switch to manual control, not to restore SCADA; RPO is the age of the last known-good PLC logic and setpoints
manual_workaround: Local (manual) control of intakes, wells, pumps, and chemical feed by licensed operators; hardwired stroke or rate limits and analyzer alarms stay active
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01 (not required in manual mode); plant power
dependent_third_parties: Bulk chemical suppliers; electric utilities; fuel contractors
quantified_impact_basis: Planning scenario: loss of treatment at GCR TP-A for 24 hours with a precautionary boil water notice for about 600,000 people. Bottled water distribution and emergency staffing about $2.9 million; flushing and sampling about $0.6 million; customer credits and lost sales about $1.1 million
acquired_system_dependency: AQ-04 to AQ-06 plants have hardwired limits but no written manual-mode procedure for each chemical (see BP-17)
single_points_of_failure: Single chlorine gas supplier for TP-A and 4 other Florida plants (DEP-15)

description: Keep pressure and storage levels with booster stations and storage tanks at about 1,900 remote sites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Low pressure risks backflow and triggers precautionary boil water notices; boosters and wells have local pressure-switch and level control
manual_workaround: Local pressure-switch and level control at boosters and tanks; roving operators set pumps by hand
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field operators; booster stations and tanks
quantified_impact_basis: Loss of pressure in 2 GCR pressure zones (about 260,000 people) for 24 hours: precautionary boil water notice, sampling, customer credits
single_points_of_failure: Private LTE core at the GCR ROCC carries 124 GCR remote sites (DEP-03)

business_process: Regional supervisory control (ROCCs, SCADA, and telemetry)
description: Monitor, alarm, and control plants and remote sites from 5 regional operations control centers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Manual operation of large plants and roving checks of remote sites can be sustained about 48 hours with overtime and mutual aid; transfer to the backup control center targeted within 2 hours (GCR); full SCADA restore from known-good media within 8 hours; historian RPO 24 hours because operators keep paper logs
manual_workaround: Transfer to the backup control center; manual operation; roving crews on 4-hour rounds; paper logs
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05 (OT identity domains)
dependent_third_parties: SCADA platform vendors; SCADA integrators; telemetry carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Licensed operators; SCADA technicians; 5 ROCCs and backup control centers
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and mutual aid for manual operation across one region (about $520,000 a day) plus integrator call-outs and deferred maintenance
acquired_system_dependency: AQ-04 to AQ-06 SCADA is supervised locally, not from a ROCC, and has no tested rebuild media (DEP-21 to DEP-23)
single_points_of_failure: GCR transfer to the backup control center took 3.5 hours against the 2-hour target (POAM-010)

business_process: Water quality monitoring, laboratories, and compliance reporting
description: Online analyzers, compliance sampling, analysis at 6 certified laboratories, and monthly reporting to primacy agencies
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Water Quality and Environmental Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Disinfectant residual and pH must be verified during any treatment disruption; missed compliance monitoring is a violation reportable to the state within 48 hours (40 CFR 141.31(b))
manual_workaround: Grab samples every 4 hours at plant outlets and distribution stations; portable kits; paper bench sheets; contract certified laboratories
dependent_third_parties: LIMS vendor; contract certified laboratories; sample couriers
quantified_impact_basis: Contract laboratory surge and courier costs, sampling overtime, and repeat sampling
single_points_of_failure: LIMS is a single SaaS instance (DEP-12)

business_process: Emergency response, public notification, and primacy agency coordination
description: Run the ERP, consult the primacy agency, and issue Tier 1 and boil water notices for any of the 126 systems
process_owner: Vice President, Resilience and Emergency Management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tier 1 notice no later than 24 hours after learning of a situation and primacy agency consultation within 24 hours (40 CFR 141.202(b)); RPO covers customer and media contact lists
manual_workaround: Monthly offline exports of customer contact lists and media contacts; broadcast media; posting and door hangers; county emergency alerting
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (call campaigns); mass notification service; SYS-12
dependent_third_parties: Mass notification vendor; broadcast media; primacy agencies; county emergency management
dependent_people_or_facilities: Regional water quality managers; communications; contact centers
quantified_impact_basis: Emergency operations center staffing, media buys, and door-hanger printing and delivery for one region
acquired_system_dependency: AQ-04 to AQ-06 still use their former owners' public notice SOPs (POAM-021)

description: Answer about 38,000 calls a day at 3 contact centers (about 1,100 agents), including outage and water quality calls
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Call volume rises 5 to 10 times during outages and notices; account lookup depends on the CIS
manual_workaround: Scripted answers; paper service orders; callbacks; forward main numbers to the backup carrier
dependent_third_parties: Telephony carrier and contact center platform vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Overflow vendor surge, agent overtime, and missed service orders

description: Bill about 3.5 million accounts in cycles, post payments, and manage collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $11.8 million of regulated revenue billed per calendar day; a delayed cycle defers cash rather than losing it; tariff rules allow estimated bills
manual_workaround: Delay bill cycles; estimated bills; the payment processor keeps taking payments
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; bill print vendor; banks
quantified_impact_basis: Billing deferred about $11.8 million per day of outage; financing cost about $45,000 per day of delay (fictional credit facility rate)

description: Collect interval reads from about 2.6 million AMI meters and manual reads for the rest; leak alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Meters store interval data for several days; estimated reads are allowed under tariff rules
manual_workaround: Estimated reads; handheld reads for priority accounts
quantified_impact_basis: Estimated-bill exceptions and delayed leak alerts

business_process: Field operations, dispatch, and work management
description: Main breaks (about 40 a day company-wide), valve and hydrant work, locates, and flushing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Main breaks need maps and valve locations quickly to isolate the break and limit pressure loss
manual_workaround: Printed map books in each truck; radio dispatch; paper work orders
dependent_third_parties: GIS and work management vendor; private LTE
quantified_impact_basis: Crew idle time and slower break isolation
single_points_of_failure: Work management is a single SaaS instance (DEP-11)

business_process: SL-1 contract operations and remote monitoring
description: 24x7 remote monitoring and operation of 38 client drinking water systems under operations and maintenance contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts commit 24x7 monitoring and alarm response; client plants have the same manual fallback as BP-01 but depend on company staff to use it
manual_workaround: On-site staffing at client plants; client local HMIs; manual operation by contract operators
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits under client contracts and on-site staffing surge at 38 client systems
single_points_of_failure: Contract-services monitoring platform runs at the GCR ROCC with a standby at the Georgia ROCC (DEP-26)

business_process: SL-2 utility billing and customer care
description: Billing, payments, contact center, and meter data management for 27 municipal clients (about 610,000 accounts)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts set bill-cycle and payment-posting commitments (payments posted within 1 business day); clients' customers call the client when bills are late
manual_workaround: Delay client bill cycles with client notice; processor keeps taking payments; client-by-client status calls
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; bill print vendor; client AMI vendors
quantified_impact_basis: About $520,000 per day of fee revenue at risk and service credits under client contracts
single_points_of_failure: Shares the CIS platform with company billing (DEP-04)

description: Order, receive, and track treatment chemicals and critical spares for 214 plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plants hold 7 to 30 days of chemical inventory; chlorine gas and caustic deliveries are weekly at large plants; RMP plants keep delivery and inventory records
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to suppliers; emergency supply agreements; mutual aid chemical sharing through WARN
dependent_people_or_facilities: Supply chain staff; plant chemical coordinators
quantified_impact_basis: Expedite fees and emergency spot purchases
single_points_of_failure: Single chlorine gas supplier for Florida plants (DEP-15)

description: Quarterly and annual close, SOX controls, and 10-Q and 10-K preparation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines at quarter-end (MTD drops to 48 hours during the close window); SOX IT general controls
manual_workaround: Extend the close calendar; manual journal entry controls with dual approval
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and audit fees; a late filing would be Severe

description: Biweekly payroll for 12,000 employees (about $34 million per run), including storm overtime
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cutoff is 72 hours before pay date; wage payment laws; retention of licensed operators
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll with adjustments through the payroll provider
quantified_impact_basis: Manual adjustments and penalties if payroll is late
acquired_system_dependency: AQ-05 and AQ-06 employees stay on legacy payroll until 2026-12-31

business_process: Engineering, GIS, and capital project delivery
description: Design, hydraulic modeling, GIS maintenance, and capital project management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Design work can pause for a week; field crews use offline map exports
manual_workaround: Offline map exports; consultant engineers work from local copies
quantified_impact_basis: Engineering productivity and capital schedule slippage

business_process: Water quality analytics and anomaly detection (AI-001)
description: Flag unusual water quality and hydraulic patterns for operator review at GCR (production) and 2 pilot systems
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Water Quality and Environmental Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory only; SCADA alarms, hardwired alarms, and grab sampling remain the controls of record; GCR operators now use it for early warning, so loss for more than 3 days reduces detection
manual_workaround: Rely on SCADA alarms; add grab sampling in the pressure zones the model watches
dependent_systems: SYS-06 (Cloud A data platform and historian replica); SYS-01 historians
quantified_impact_basis: Extra grab sampling in monitored pressure zones
single_points_of_failure: Single historian replication path through the GCR OT DMZ (DEP-27)

business_process: Operations at AQ-04 to AQ-06 (legacy SCADA)
description: Treatment, distribution, and supervisory control at the three acquired systems not yet integrated (5 plants, about 139,300 people)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same public health drivers as BP-01; PLC logic backups exist only at the former owners' integrators and are about 7 days old at best, so the real RPO is about 168 hours against the 24-hour enterprise target
manual_workaround: Manual operation by licensed operators; hardwired limits; no written manual-mode procedure for each chemical yet
dependent_systems: AQ legacy SCADA; site VPNs; local accounts
quantified_impact_basis: Manual operation staffing and precautionary notice costs for about 139,300 people
acquired_system_dependency: Yes: AQ-04 to AQ-06 are the process
single_points_of_failure: Legacy SCADA servers at each system (single instance, no tested restore); vendor remote desktop tools (POAM-001)
